Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announces a four-day special session of Parliament from November 30 to December 3, with significant legislative business scheduled in both Houses. Rijiju also hits back at opposition leaders calling the session unconstitutional, urging all MPs to participate in meaningful debate and ensure smooth proceedings.
